newsitem.title: USA: IMF approves second annual ESAF loan for Georgia.
newsitem.headline: IMF approves second annual ESAF loan for Georgia.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund on Monday approved the second annual loan for Georgia amounting to $76 million to support the country's economic program for this year.
The loan, made under the IMF's Enchanced Structural Adjustment Facility, is available in two semi-annual installments, the first of which will be made on April 4.

The IMF said the economic program for this year calls for growth of eight to 10 percent compared with an estimate of 10.5 percent last year and a reduction in consumer price increases to 11 to 13 percent from 39 percent last year.
The program also includes reducing the current account deficit to 6.7 percent from 7.6 percent this year with official reserves of the equivalent of 2.5 months of imports.

The IMF also said the Georgian authorities were committed to accelerating the implementation of structural reforms including the energy sector while pursuing an ambitious privatization program for medium and large scale enterprises.
